FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Backend Updates
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A handful of backend updates to help cleanup the code a bit.

patchNoteLines.li: Backend code updates. User-facing behavior should not change.

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Production Rework
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Reworks how resource production is calculated and displayed. All values are now calculated in per-day increments, added up each day before being disbursed on the tax tick. The net income should be the same, but the affect of mid-cycle production differences should be more obvious than the old average-of-daily-snapshots system.\n\nAlso, tithing has been slightly reworked. The tithes list is now a priority list of items. You can list more items than your settlement can afford, and when the tax tick comes, you will be sent the first N items that fit within the tithe limit.

patchNoteLines.li: Resource production rework: all values are calculated on a daily basis. The length of the tax cycle merely determines how frequently acrued production is sent to the player
Minor tithes rework: the tithe item list is now a priority list, sending the first N items that fit within the tithe budget

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: New Feature: Situations
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Adds Situations, shamelessly stolen from - er, inspired by - Stellaris. Situations feature a meter that can tick up or down over time, as well as the opportunity for the player to pick one of several 'approaches' to influence how the Situation resolves.\n\nThis initial implementation is a rough first pass. It needs further UI work, and to also be more featureful in general (not to mention it needs actual Situations to be used with).

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Minor Fixes & Features
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A variety of minor bugfixes, changes, and features.

patchNoteLines.li: When a settlement defends itself in a manual defense battle without an assigned squad, its defenders are assembled from the player's unit designs
Food resource is now Farming, and features all resources that can be harvested from plants (except for medicine and drugs, which continue to belong to the Medicine resource (except for beer))
The Mining resource now only allows rock types belonging to the settlement's tile. Obsidian is only titheable in the Lava Field biome
Add difficulty settings for global worker base production and worker production multipliers. Higher difficulties have a harsh multiplier; lower difficulties are now swimming in resources
Allow more than one event window to be open at a time
When the player defeats an NPC settlement through a normal vanilla attack, they are now given the option to capture the settlement for their empire

When generating a manual defense battle map, all turrets are stripped if the player doesn't have the tech for them. This was unnecessary for Empire itself, but *is* necessary when using other mods for base gen, such as Vanilla Base Generation Expanded
In manual defense battles, civilian pawns' names are rendered in a muted color compared to the defender pawns, making them easier to tell apart
Bugfix: the "Settlement Formed" letter that's sent after capturing an enemy settlement would not report the correct name

Leathers that do not come directly from an animal (e.g. patchleather) are moved from the Animals resource to the Apparel resource. In theory, this should provide compatibility with Vanilla Factions Expanded: Midieval 2 as well
Add a mod setting to let the player control how frequently (or infrequently) their roads build
